judgment: it should be as at midday.
image: Thunder and lightning both arrive: Fullness.
So the noble one settles lawsuits,
lines: Meeting the lord who matches him:
though ten days pass, no harm.
at midday the Dipper is seen.
There is trust, breaking out: good.
at midday small stars are seen.
at midday the Dipper is seen.
Meeting the lord, his equal: good.
A full house, the household screened off.
Peering in at the door: still, no one there.

notes.name_en: 豐 is largeness/fullness at its height; 'Fullness', not Wilhelm's 'Abundance'.
notes.L2: 日中見斗 stars visible at noon — eclipse or darkness at fullness, kept literal.
notes.L4: 夷主 the level/equal lord (parallel 配主 in L1); Phase 5 review replaced 'in the half-light', which had no word in the slot.
